about.subtitle: WHO'S PATRICK?
about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: Hi, I'm Patrick. I've always wanted to figure out how things work and use that insight to shape new things. Software development and coding let me do exactly that. Understanding systems and logic and then building something practical from them is what drives me to keep improving toward the best-fitting solution, learn new technologies, and bring projects to life.
about.paragraph2: Let's work together and create something meaningful that brings value to others!
about.workMode2: Hybrid: within daily commuting range, ideally 3 days on-site / 2 remote (flexible by arrangement). Beyond commuting distance, 1–2 multi-day on-site visits per month with overnight stay — just not on Mondays.

skills.subtitle: MY STACK
skills.title: Skill Set
skills.intro: I started dev with R/R-Shiny, then Python, but found more joy in creating UI/UX combined with a solid backend. I chose the web stack for its constant learning and endless challenges even in AI age.

projects.subtitle: MY CRAFT
projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Curious? Take a look at the projects below - every interaction is a design decision, every detail a deliberate choice. Frontend-focused builds, with Supabase when a backend is needed.
projects.rec1Text: I got to know Patrick as a consistent and reliable developer. He finds great solutions even when bugs come up and brings a high level of expertise, especially in the area of databases. His clear communication rounds off a very pleasant collaboration.
projects.rec2Text: Patrick Schauer was a reliable and helpful team member on the 'Join' project. He placed great importance on good team structure and fair task distribution, ensuring everyone could take on suitable responsibilities. Particularly noteworthy are his supportive nature, strong organisational skills, and the pleasant collaboration within the team.

join.description: A Kanban-inspired task manager 📌 that keeps work flowing — drag tasks across columns, assign teammates, and group everything by category so nothing slips through.
join.implementation: Built as a single-page Angular app with Supabase as the backend for auth and data. Tasks are persisted in real time, drag-and-drop is implemented with the Angular CDK, and the UI is fully responsive down to mobile.

epl.description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer 🎮 written in object-oriented JavaScript — guide Pepe through the desert, grab coins and tabasco bottles, and take down the boss hen.
epl.implementation: A side-scrolling platformer rendered on HTML5 Canvas. The architecture is class-based: separate entities for the player, enemies, collectibles, and the world, each with their own update/draw cycle driven by a central game loop.
